rootCause: ProjectTimelineService.getTimeline does `new Date(from)` then `d.toISOString().slice(0,10)` (project-timeline.service.ts:65-69). `from` is a REQUIRED query param (controller @Query('from'), no DTO validation, no default). When the request omits `from`, `from` is undefined -> `new Date(undefined)` is Invalid Date -> `toISOString()` throws RangeError: Invalid time value, which surfaces as HTTP 500. There is no ParseDate/ValidationPipe guarding the param, so a missing/garbage `from` reaches the date loop and crashes instead of returning a 400.
stack:
RangeError: Invalid time value
    at Date.toISOString (<anonymous>)
    at ProjectTimelineService.getTimeline (/app/dist/src/modules/staffing-desk/application/project-timeline.service.js:29:31)
    at StaffingDeskController.projectTimeline (/app/dist/src/modules/staffing-desk/presentation/staffing-desk.controller.js:61:44)
    at /app/node_modules/@nestjs/core/router/router-execution-context.js:38:29
    at process.processTicksAndRejections (node:internal/process/task_queues:95:5)
suggestedFix: Validate `from` at the controller boundary so a missing/invalid value yields 400, not 500. Either (a) introduce a small DTO with @IsDateString() on `from` (and @IsOptional @IsInt on weeks/poolId/projectId) bound via @Query() under the global ValidationPipe, or (b) guard in the service: if (!from || isNaN(new Date(from).getTime())) throw new BadRequestException('from is required (YYYY-MM-DD)'). Option (a) is consistent with the other DTO-validated query endpoints in this module.
uiCaller: frontend/src/lib/api/staffing-desk.ts:fetchProjectTimeline (always sets `from` via URLSearchParams) called by frontend/src/components/staffing-desk/ProjectTimeline.tsx:109, which derives `from = addDays(baseMonday, weekOffset*7)` from getCurrentWeekMonday() and always passes weeks. The UI NEVER sends an empty `from`, so this crash is unreachable through normal app usage; it only fires on a hand-crafted no-param request (the QA probe).
